mapper.sql: SELECT spu.id AS spuId, sku.id AS skuId, spu.name AS productName, sku.name AS productSkuName, sku_ext.isbn AS isbn FROM product_sku sku INNER JOIN product_spu spu ON spu.id = sku.spu_id AND spu.deleted = b'0' LEFT JOIN product_publication_sku_ext sku_ext ON sku_ext.sku_id = sku.id AND sku_ext.deleted = b'0'
mapper.select: ORDER BY spu.sort ASC, spu.id DESC, sku.id ASC

WHERE sku.deleted = b'0' AND spu.biz_scene = 'PUBLICATION' AND sku.id IN
#{skuId}
